evidence_class: post-outcome read-only descriptive audit of burned SCORPION; not a new frozen model comparison
provenance: Verbatim numerical values transcribed from user's local PowerShell audit console. Original result and audit JSON remain locally stored; no uploaded JSON verified here.
independent_unit: 48 original source slides, after averaging three model seeds and four scanner holdouts per slide
rt3_frozen_promotion_gate_failure: isotropic-minus-residual-tangent heldout alignment MSE 95% lower bound was not positive; RT3 FAIL
interpretation: Isotropic regularization was better on the frozen alignment head-to-head, so original RT3 gate does not pass.
Isotropic had lower retrieval, higher known-scanner probe accuracy, and higher reference reconstruction MSE than residual-tangent, an unfavorable descriptive retention tradeoff.
Residual-tangent achieved near-control retrieval and improved scanner probe while much lowering heldout alignment MSE, but reconstruction MSE worsened relative to the no-inverse control.

Nonzero high retrieval argues against complete constant-latent collapse; these aggregate metrics cannot establish preservation of diagnostically/biologically useful information or rule out partial rank contraction.
The final training variance-floor penalty was near zero but does not prove heldout latent rank or biological sufficiency.
cannot_claim: that residual-tangent is a confirmed scientific winner
that isotropic smoothing is biologically invalid or truly collapsed
independent confirmation, clinical utility, or patient-level validity
next_action: Do not tune or rerun RT3 on burned SCORPION; secure genuinely independent paired physical-slide acquisitions and independent biological labels/diagnostic endpoints, then prospectively freeze tissue-retention and scanner-invariance gates before evaluation.
